neighbours.label: 'same' in a phrase of approximate time: 'around / about / roughly the same time / period'; not 'at the same time' (simultaneous) and not sameness of things
fire: The first printing presses reached Venice around the same time as the plague.
He left the army, and at about the same time his brother joined the navy.
Both churches were built in roughly the same period, a generation apart.
Radio arrived in the village around the same time that the road was paved.
The two poets were born around the same year and died within months of each other.
Her second novel appeared at about the same time as the film.
Farming began in China at around the same time as in the Near East.
The two fossils date from approximately the same period of the Jurassic.
quiet: The first printing presses reached Venice a few years before the plague.
He can whistle and juggle at the same time without dropping a ball.
Both churches were built with the same stone from the local quarry.
Radio arrived in the village shortly after the road was paved.
The two poets wore the same hat and were often mistaken for each other.
Her second novel has the same heroine as the film.
Farming began in China around nine thousand years ago.
The two fossils come from the same quarry in southern Germany.

notes: Probes: 'around the same time' 0.63, 'roughly the same period' 0.60, 'in the same era' 0.33; 'at the same time' 0.06, 'the same colour' 0.09, 'the same dish' 0.04. The opposite pole takes 'same' for identical things ('the same value', 'the same path'), so the unit seems to separate approximate coincidence in time from plain identity.
